Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ اللَّيَالِيْ وَالدُّهُورِ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, as numerous as the nights and ages

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ أَمْوَاجِ الْبُحُورِ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, as numerous as the waves of the seas

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَ رَحْمَتُهُ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, and His mercy is better than what they accumulate

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ الشَّوْكِ وَالشَّجَرِ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, as numerous as the thorns and trees

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ الشَّعْرِ وَالْوَبَرِ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, as numerous as the hairs and furs

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ الْحَجَرِ وَالْمَدَرِ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, as numerous as the stones and clods of earth

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ لَمْحِ الْعُيُونِ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, as numerous as the glances of eyes

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فِيْ اللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, in the night when it darkens and the morning when it breathes

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ الرِّيَاحِ فِيْ الْبَرَارِيْ وَالصُّخُورِ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, as numerous as the winds in the wilderness and rocks

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مِنَ الْيَوْمِ إِلٰى يَوْمِ يُنْفَخُ فِيْ الصُّورِ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, from today until the day when the trumpet is blown
